About the Role:
 
We are searching for a Senior Associate to join our dynamic team to handle day-to-day financial operations and reporting for our diverse portfolio of entities, along with quarterly and month-end closing activities. You will handle traditional accounting duties while gaining unique exposure to Web3 accounting, digital assets, and cryptocurrency reconciliation.

Responsibilities:

  • Liaise with external auditors for statutory audits, collate testing samples, and prepare accounting memos

  • Manage the full-set bookkeeping for up to 20 standalone entities across various jurisdictions (including Hong Kong, Middle East, United Kingdom, Korea, and Cayman Island etc.)

  • Handle daily accounting operations including monthly subsidiary funding and cost recharges

  • Ensure invoices are prepared correctly and accurately updated in the accounting system

  • Verify invoices and agreements to ensure the validity of supporting documents and proper authorization

  • Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded in the ledger

  • Manage Accounts Payable settled in cryptocurrency, ensuring crypto payments are properly recorded and reconciled with on-chain transactions

  • Perform ad hoc assignments, including but not limited to accounting standard interpretation and the development of accounting policies and procedures

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and provide guidance or mentorship to junior team members

Requirements:

  • 3 years of relevant experience, preferably with a mix of Big 4 audit and commercial accounting, less experience can be considered as a Senior Associate

  • QP candidate / CPA is a plus 

  • Proficiency in modern ERP systems (e.g. Oracle, NetSuite, or Expensify)

  • Experience with the Microsoft Office suite of programs is essential

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Good time management and an organized approach to tasks

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Ability to take ownership and responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team

  • A professional and positive attitude, remaining patient and calm under pressure

  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

The Perks of Joining Animoca Brands:
A Vibrant and Diverse Workplace: Immerse yourself in a dynamic, multi-cultural environment with colleagues from over 15 nationalities (and growing!). We celebrate diversity and foster a global perspective.
Incentives in the Web3 Space: Be a part of the future and align your success with the growth of our innovative projects.
Direct Impact and Flat Structure: Your voice matters. We operate with a flat organizational structure, ensuring your ideas are heard and implemented quickly.
Comfortable and Creative Atmosphere: Embrace a relaxed and productive work environment with casual attire.
Opportunities Across the Ecosystem: Expand your horizons by collaborating with various subsidiary brands within the Animoca Brands network, gaining exposure to a wide range of projects and technologies.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: We care about your well-being. Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, life, and transportation allowances.

Personal Information Collection Statement:
Personal data provided by the Job Applicant will be used strictly in accordance with the Employer's Personal Data Policies, a copy of which will be provided immediately upon his/her request. All classified data will be treated confidentially within the Human Resources & Administration Department. Personal data of unsuccessful applicants may be retained for a period of up to 3 months.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

DriveWealth is hiring a Sales Support Analyst for our Korea office. Reporting directly to the Head of APAC, this role combines high-level executive support with client relationship management and sales enablement. We are looking for mature, dynamic individuals who excel in fast-paced, high-growth environments and can drive operational and client success across the region.

What You’ll Do

  • Executive & Regional Support: Provide strategic leverage and operational support directly to the Head of APAC, managing calendars, travel logistics, expense reports, and regional priorities
  • Sales Enablement & Pitch Preparation: Assist in preparing client-facing materials, tailored pitch decks, briefing documents, and market research for sales meetings and partner engagements
  • Relationship Management Support: Act as a key liaison for existing APAC client relationships, tracking follow-ups, resolving routine inquiries, and maintaining CRM/pipeline records
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate communication between APAC leadership, clients, external partners, and global internal teams (product, compliance, operations)
  • Workplace Experience: Act as the face of our Seoul office by greeting guests and candidates at reception. You will manage the daily food and beverage operations (team lunches and snacks) and ensure the office environment is organized and professional
  • Events: Plan and execute internal and external gatherings, including team onsites, offsites, and partner visits, handling everything from venue sourcing to catering and transportation
  • Discretion: Handle sensitive information with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and emotional intelligence

You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client success, sales operations, or executive support within financial services or fintech
  • Proven track record supporting client relationships, sales pipelines, and regional business development initiatives in APAC
  • High agency and proactive ownership; ability to manage multiple client and internal priorities for executive leadership without prompting
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience preparing high-impact client pitch decks and executive briefings
  • Systems-thinking skills and proficiency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and Google Workspace to streamline operational workflows
  • Fluent in English and Korean, with exceptional cross-cultural negotiation and relationship-building abilities
  • A "force multiplier" mindset, naturally anticipating the needs of the Head of APAC and regional partners
  • High emotional intelligence and discretion when handling sensitive commercial, partner, and operational data

Special Knowledge (Nice to Have, But Not Required)

  • Understanding of brokerage, capital markets, or wealth management technology landscape in APAC
  • Experience working with cross-functional global teams in product, compliance, and legal within financial services

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Seoul, South Korea - Hybrid; is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the manager/team.

If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in Korea. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Description

AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders, we try new things, and imagine big dreams. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, testers, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud technologies that enable our customers to adopt cloud based solutions.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

FSI Digital Natives Solutions Architects (SA) work closely with technical decision maker, co-founders, engineers and developers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Our Solutions Architects also take a leading role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.

THE ROLE

You will collaborate with customers, partners and other AWS teams to craft architectures, proof of concepts and demonstrations of our platform that work back from customer's business needs and accelerate the adoption of appropriate AWS technology. You will help shape and design solutions covering a spread of tech concerns like security, tenant isolation in compute and storage, hybrid networking, CI/CD to reduce time to market, rightsizing and auto-scaling of infrastructure, purpose-built databases to name a few. The ability to learn new technology and develop industry relevant architectures and convey business value is critical to the role.

What if I don’t meet all the requirements? That’s okay! We hire people who have a passion for learning and are curious. You will be supported in your career development here at AWS. You will have plenty of opportunities to build your technical, leadership, business and consulting skills. Your on-boarding will set you up for success, including a combination of formal and informal training. You’ll also have a chance to gain AWS certifications and access mentor-ship programs. You will learn from and collaborate with some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today.

Key job responsibilities
- Work directly with customers to accelerate their projects and recommend best-practice cloud architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
- Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical business problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures
- Scope and own each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well- defined objectives and success criteria
- Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Customer Solution Managers and consulting/managed services partners)
- Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops

A day in the life
Solutions Architects (SA) are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The key to AWS success is its top-tier collaborative culture. You will have the opportunity to work with multiple AWS professionals that can help you accelerate your career and bring ideas to market. You will be working closely with a talented team of managers and SAs that will push your technical abilities while you bring new innovations to a widely adopted and fast-growing service, and become an expert in the industry.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
    - 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
    - 6+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
    - Proficient in English, Cantonese and Mandarin are required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
    - Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
    - Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

    Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
descriptions.job-1t3zjsf:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. And right now, our social presence doesn't reflect how good the product actually is.

You're going to fix that.

 

The opportunity

We’re seeking a chronically online, Social Media Lead to drive Kraken Pro social channels. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the communities we serve is essential and social is at the forefront of that.

We’re looking for someone who moves fast but thinks long-term, thrives under pressure, and knows how to launch new products while creating ecosystem content that cuts through the noise. This role demands sharp content creation skills, an analytical mindset, and a self-starter attitude.

  • Craft scroll-stopping, platform-native content for X, Telegram, and beyond to maximize impact and reach for Kraken Pro.

  • Win the moment. Spot trends and reactive moments across CT/FinTwit and broader social, then rapidly craft timely, on-brand content.

  • Be the heartbeat of the community. Actively engage with the Kraken Pro audience. Reply, quote, poll, meme, and foster meaningful conversation.

  • Run an always-on calendar. Build and maintain a content calendar: create posts, route for approvals, schedule, publish, and monitor performance.

  • Integrate key updates. Translate product and ecosystem news into clear, compelling narratives.

  • Measure what matters. Track growth and performance and iterate based on insights and experiments.

  • Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.

     

What you’ll bring

  • Receipts. Posts you wrote that broke out, on a brand account or your own or that you manage. We care more about what you've made than where you've worked.

  • 3+ years in social or content, ideally fintech, crypto, or trading. Exceptional portfolios beat exceptional résumés here.

  • Speed under pressure. Markets don't wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

  • Range as a maker. Copy, memes, short-form video, charts, threads. You don't need a design queue to get a post out.

  • Taste. Knowing when not to post is as valuable as knowing when to.

  • Comfortable handling high-paced social channels

  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

  • Creative and detail-oriented, with the ability to produce visually appealing content - whether it be briefing the design team, using Figma or being scrappy on CapCut

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Circle is looking for an Analyst to join its Treasury Fund Management team in Bermuda, supporting the daily management and continued growth of USYC, Circle’s tokenized money market fund. You’ll contribute to the accurate and timely execution of fund activities spanning liquidity and portfolio management, trade settlement, NAV and token-price validation, subscriptions and redemptions, on-chain transactions, service-provider coordination, risk monitoring, and operational controls. You’ll work closely with partners across Treasury, Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk, as well as external fund administrators, custodians, investment managers, banking partners, and other service providers. As Circle’s fund platform evolves, you’ll also have opportunities to support new fund-related capabilities and selected Treasury initiatives.

  • Execute and monitor daily fund operations, including NAV and token-price validation, cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, trade settlement, subscriptions and redemptions, portfolio reconciliations, and exception resolution.

  • Coordinate token minting, burning, transfers, and reconciliations while working with fund administrators, custodians, investment managers, banking partners, and other service providers to support accurate and timely execution.

  • Support USYC and new fund-related capabilities by contributing operational analysis, workflows, controls, reporting, documentation, audit evidence, and regulatory or compliance requests.

  • Identify recurring exceptions and opportunities to strengthen controls and scalability, contributing to automation, process improvements, business-continuity planning, and other Treasury initiatives.

Core Requirements

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in fund operations, treasury, asset management, financial services, capital markets, or fintech.

  • Hands-on experience with fund operations such as cash management, trade settlement, NAV review, portfolio reconciliation, subscriptions and redemptions, or investment reporting.

  • Working knowledge of investment products and markets, with exposure to money market funds, fixed income, government securities, repurchase agreements, private funds, credit strategies, or similar products.

  • Experience working with fund administrators, custodians, banks, investment managers, or other financial-market service providers.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • Familiarity with digital assets, tokenized financial instruments, blockchain networks, digital-asset custody, wallet operations, or token mint-and-burn processes.

  • Progress toward or completion of a relevant professional qualification, such as the CFA, CPA, ACCA, or CAIA.

descriptions.job-0jfs4dr:
Start your tech sales career with people who actually want to teach you. 

We’re hiring early-career folks who are curious, coachable, and ready to learn how modern enterprise sales really works. You don’t need a sales background — you need to be sharp, willing to pick up the phone, and excited to build something. We’ll handle the rest. 

The role, in plain terms 

You’ll be the first person from ComplyAdvantage that a potential customer talks to. That means researching companies, figuring out who the right person to reach is, and then actually reaching out — by phone, email, LinkedIn, or in person at industry events — to book a meeting with one of our account executives. It’s the front door of the sales process, and it matters. 

It’s also the role where most great enterprise sales careers begin. 

What your day looks like 

You’ll spend your time researching accounts and forming a real point of view on what’s happening in their world, then reaching out to senior decision-makers at companies. You’ll work inbound leads that come in, dig into what those prospects actually need, and prep meetings so your account executives walk in ready. You’ll join industry events, build a personal brand on LinkedIn, and get smarter about financial crime, compliance, and regtech every single week. 

What we’ll teach you 

We’ve built a Go-To-Market team that takes training seriously — not as a one-week onboarding then sink-or-swim, but as an ongoing thing. You’ll learn a structured sales playbook that’s been refined over years, get coaching from experienced reps and managers, and build genuine expertise in a complex, interesting industry. The BDRs who do well here move into Account Executive, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations roles. We want this to be your launchpad. 

You might be a great fit if 

You’re naturally curious and like understanding how things work. You’re not afraid to start a conversation with someone senior — or you’re willing to get comfortable with it. You take feedback well and actually apply it. You want to be good at something hard, and you’re patient enough to put in the reps. A background in sales isn’t required — strong candidates have come from hospitality, retail, campus leadership, athletics, customer service, internships, and plenty of other places. 

Basic qualifications 

  • At least one (1) year of work experience in a sales, customer-facing, or professional role. Internships, part-time jobs, on-campus leadership roles, hospitality, retail, and customer service all count. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US without current or future sponsorship.

What’s in it for you? 

  • Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building
  • Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best
  • Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
  • Budget to set up your home office upon joining
  • Parental leave and childcare benefits
  • Life Insurance to protect your loved ones
  • Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses
  • 401k Contribution
  • Financial Perks (Financial Advice, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance)
  • Pre-Tax transit benefits

Ready? 

If you’ve read this far and something in it clicked, apply. We’d rather hear from someone who’s curious and a little nervous than someone who’s perfectly polished. 

The base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $67,000 + commission, equity, and US benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

The Technical Program Manager is the operational backbone of the Standards and Governance functions within the Central Operations pillar. Reporting to the Director of Standards and Governance, this mid-senior individual contributor runs the document governance lifecycle, drives root cause analyses and their corrective actions to verified closure, coordinates SOC and ISO audit readiness, and holds the throughline across these programs. The role exists so this work can scale as Riot brings new data center capacity and customers online.

This position will be based in our Rockdale or Austin office. Relocation assistance is available for non-local candidates. 

What you'll do

Governance Document Lifecycle

  • Own the day-to-day operation of the operations document library across the full hierarchy of policies, standards, processes, procedures, and forms.
  • Run the document routing and approval chain, tracking each document through subject-matter, governance, organizational, and final approval.
  • Maintain the review cadence so standards and procedures stay current against customer agreements, infrastructure changes, RCA findings, and audit findings.
  • Keep the library controlled and audit-ready, with version control, ownership, and status accurate at all times.

Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions

  • Coordinate the RCA program end to end: intake, facilitation support, and tracking against customer SLA windows
  • Drive corrective and preventive actions to verified closure, each with a named owner, due date, and effectiveness check.
  • Maintain the corrective-action tracker and produce status reporting for leadership and customers.
  • Identify recurrence and escalate it per the Root Cause Analysis Standard.

SOC Audit & Compliance Coordination

  • Serve as an operations coordination point for SOC & ISO audits.
  • Assemble and manage evidence, respond to auditor requests, and drive readiness for each scheduled audit wave.
  • Cross-Functional Program Management
  • Coordinate across Operational Readiness, IT/OT, EHS, and site operations to keep governance and RCA work moving.
  • Support rollout and adoption of operations systems of record (CMMS and incident management platforms).
  • Manage program schedules, dependencies, and status communication to technical and executive audiences.
  • Support Incident Management coordination – intake, coordination, communication during onsite incidents.

What you'll have

  • 5+ years in program or project management, governance, quality, compliance, or operations
  • 8+ years experience with mission critical environments such as: data centers, critical facilities, manufacturing, oil & gas, or another audited environment.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating audits or compliance programs (SOC, ISO, or comparable).
  • Experience running or supporting root cause analysis and corrective action programs.
  • Strong document and records management discipline with a high bar for accuracy and detail.
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to coordinate stakeholders across technical and executive audiences.
  • Proficiency with work or records systems such as a CMMS/EAM, ticketing, or document management platform.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

You’ll own the day-to-day Payment Operations function supporting Circle Payments Network, with accountability for operational coverage, queue performance, escalations, investigation quality, team capability, and process execution across a 24x7 environment. You’ll develop analysts from onboarding through independent case ownership, maintain a high bar for operational quality, and ensure the team has the processes, training, documentation, and performance management needed to operate effectively. You’ll also be the domain expert on the network and the senior operational escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved within the team.

What you'll work on

  • Own shift design, rostering, coverage planning, and handoffs across a 24x7 model, including leave, surge and holiday planning, and the coverage math that sits behind it.

  • Own live queue management, ensuring incoming partner queries and detected exceptions are picked up, triaged, worked, and closed within SLA.

  • Own the escalation path. Senior Analysts are the first escalation point and work the hardest cases; you take what they cannot resolve and decide when an issue needs to leave the team and move to Engineering, Product, or partner-facing leadership.

  • Build and run analyst onboarding, continuous training, certification, and competency development, using actual case output to identify individual gaps, build targeted improvement plans, and develop analysts from day one through independent handling of the full query mix.

  • Establish and operate the QC program, including case sampling, review, calibration, error taxonomy, investigation standards, and feedback loops into training and SOPs.

  • Own the operational metrics the function reports on, including Time to Acknowledge (TTA), Time to Resolve (TTR), SLA compliance, and volume and failure trends by shift, partner, and rail; produce the weekly operations readout and be able to explain any number in it.

  • Develop and maintain current, usable SOPs and runbooks that reflect how the team actually works; close gaps between practice and documentation, and run process changes through communication, training, adoption verification, and measurement.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

  • 8+ years in payment operations, payment investigations, settlement operations, or a comparable operations function at a payments company, fintech, or bank.

  • 2+ years directly managing a team of operations analysts as a Team Lead, Assistant Manager, or Manager, with real accountability for their output and not just work allocation; you are still hands-on and want to stay that way.

  • Hands-on ownership of at least one full shift roster in a 24x7 or extended-coverage operation; you have built the roster, run the coverage math, and handled the exceptions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of training and ramp; you can name analysts you took from new to independent and describe how you developed them.

  • Demonstrated ownership of process and documentation; you have written SOPs and runbooks that other people used, not just followed someone else’s.

  • Cross-border payments depth, including correspondent banking, SWIFT/MT103, local rails, reconciliation, exception handling, and settlement investigations.

  • Comfortable working from data; you set targets, track them, and can defend the numbers.

What will make you stand out

  • You have done this in a team that was being built, not one that was already running; you set the process rather than inheriting it.

  • You have run an operation where the SLA mattered to a customer or partner, and you can describe what you changed to hit it.

  • You have exposure to stablecoins, crypto rails, or digital assets, or clear evidence that you pick up new domains quickly.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for thoughtful problem-solvers and builders who want to make a meaningful contribution. Robinhood is a place where people take ownership of their work and help improve financial access for all. We operate with high standards, clear accountability, and a strong focus on security and ethics in everything we build!

The Red Team’s mission is to identify and reduce real-world security risks across Robinhood by simulating adversary behavior and testing defenses. As a Staff Offensive Security Engineer, you will plan and execute security assessments across applications, infrastructure, and physical environments, and partner closely with engineering and security teams to strengthen detection and response capabilities. You will help prioritize risk, contribute to remediation efforts, and develop tools and techniques that improve how we test and secure our systems. Your work will directly support the safety and reliability of products used by millions of customers.

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA, New York, NY, Denver, CO or Menlo Park, CA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Evangelize the Offensive Security Team’s Findings and Projects with stakeholders throughout the company and collaborate with other teams to create solutions that balance security with other priorities.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to the members of the Offensive Security team.
  • Plan and execute red team exercises, including long-term assessments that simulate real-world attack scenarios
  • Perform threat modeling and penetration testing across applications, infrastructure, and corporate environments
  • Develop scripts and tools to support and automate security testing activities
  • Partner with detection and response teams to run adversarial simulations and improve incident readiness
  • Communicate findings clearly and work with engineering teams to remediate identified risks
  • Lead Security Incidents when Pentest or Red Team findings require them.
  • Plan and participate in Adversarial Simulation exercises with various security teams.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience conducting red team operations or advanced penetration testing
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of other security engineers
  • Passion and demonstrated experience for challenging security assumptions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate your findings at many different levels of abstraction from Engineers to Executives.
  • Passion for fixing security issues and not just identifying security issues.
  • Familiarity with common network protocols and standards such as DNS and TCP/IP.
  • Experience with MacOS and Linux.
  • Experience with leveraging components of a modern software development stack to attack companies, including CI, container orchestration systems (Kubernetes/Docker), cloud providers (AWS, GCP), etc and be able to give hardening suggestions.
  • Experience/knowledge of defensive tools/techniques (IDS/IPS, Packet Capture, Network Analysis, AV, EDR, etc.) and how to evade them.
  • Deep understanding of Mitre’s ATT&CK Framework.
  • Strong understanding of the security fundamentals of access and identity.
  • Comfortable reading / writing python, go, and javascript.
  • Ability to research and execute a testing plan to access a new technology or process.
  • Demonstrated experience working with a distributed team.
  • Proficiency to communicate over a text-based medium (Slack, JIRA Issues, GitHub issues, & Email) and can succinctly document technical details.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in the Financial Technology domain.
  • Experience being a technical lead at other organizations.

What we offer

  • Market competitive and pay equity-focused compensation structure
  • 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Annual lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more!
  • Lifetime maximum benefit for family forming and fertility benefits
  • Dedicated mental health support for employees and eligible dependents
  • Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。

3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。

4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。

descriptions.job-000nw1b:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Build Alpaca's internal infrastructure and developer platform as a product. You own the product definition and platform maturity strategy, the intake, the backlog, and the multi-quarter roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure, and you put the rails in place so DevOps, Platform, and Infrastructure teams, and the customers know what to prioritize next. Partnering directly with the VP of Engineering.

Alpaca is building infrastructure for programmable finance at global scale: new countries, global markets, products that must stay centralized, and products that must be deployable in any region. This seat exists so that work has a product owner — platform maturity, CI/CD, cost efficiency and attribution, and the infrastructure dependencies that product engineering keeps discovering too late.

Things You Get To Do

Own infrastructure as a product. Define and evolve a platform maturity model in the open. Internal customers are Alpaca engineers. The north star matches the Platform & Infrastructure charter: self-serve infrastructure on paved golden paths – any engineer can build, ship, authenticate, observe, and scale a service without filing a ticket. You are the product owner for Foundational Infrastructure inside the TPM team: efficiency (cost attribution / chargeback) and the KPIs that prove the platform is getting easier to consume (full CI/CD delivery and adoption).

Build the rails for monthly delivery. Teams already carve capacity for on-call, support, and upgrades. What remains is discovery and delivery. You make the next pull from a living roadmap obvious. You keep the central backlog and intake sane. You surface platform and infrastructure dependencies before they become surprises on someone else's roadmap.

Drive platform maturity until maintenance windows disappear. Short term you will feel the pain of coordinating maintenance windows, runbooks, and market-hours constraints — because you cannot eliminate what you have not operated. The goal is 24/7 deployability across open and closed markets, globally. 

Make the cost a first-class product surface. Work with infrastructure engineering and Finance on attribution, chargeback, and efficiency. This requires technical judgment: you have to understand why a node, a database, or a pipeline costs what it costs. Cost is one program, not the whole job.

Raise CI/CD and developer-platform adoption. Full CI/CD delivery and adoption is a stated KPI for this seat. Partner with DevOps App (ArgoCD, service mesh, API gateway) and Platform (AuthX, event streaming, DevEx) so golden paths get used, not documented and ignored.

Make infrastructure portable for global scale. Distinguish what must stay centralized to serve all of Alpaca from what must be packaged and deployable in new markets Alpaca will expand to. 

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 7+ years as a TPM, product manager technical, or equivalent, with a substantial portion of that time owning infrastructure, platform or developer experience.
  • You have owned a multi-team backlog, intake, and roadmap, and you have run a planning cadence that teams actually use.
  • You are technically fluent to be an equal partner to senior/staff engineers on compute infra, deployment pipelines (CI/CD), data stores, networking, and cost drivers. While you do not need to write production Terraform; you do need to know when a proposal is hand-wavy.
  • You get things done without a reporting line. You have influenced platform adoption across many teams.
  • You write and operate with crisp scope. You can say what this role does not own and still leave no gap.
  • You have worked in a market-hours-sensitive or regulated production environment, or another domain where deploy windows, change risk, and customer trust are real constraints.
  • You use AI and automation to remove program toil rather than add tooling.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • You have stood up a platform-maturity model, paved-path program, or internal developer platform.
  • You have eliminated or dramatically reduced maintenance windows or change-freeze culture in a production org.
  • Multi-region or multi-entity infrastructure: packaging a platform so a new region or booking center can be stood up without a hero project.
  • Capital markets, brokerage, or other FinTech infrastructure.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Preferred qualifications

Private Wealth & Digital Assets Lead - US

Project-Based Role with Potential to Become Permanent

About Tangem

Tangem is a Swiss self-custody technology company founded in 2017. We develop secure, easy-to-use NFC hardware wallets and have sold more than 6 million cards across 200+ countries, with a global team of 300+ people.

We see a potential opportunity for Tangem in the professional wealth and institutional segment, including family offices, HNWs, wealth managers, RIAs, corporate treasuries, and other financial institutions.

Our goal is not to become a regulated custodian, but to explore whether Tangem can serve as a secure self-custody and access-control solution, independently or alongside existing custody infrastructure.

The Role

We are looking for a senior US financial-services professional to lead a focused market research and strategy project.

We do not want to start with a predefined product or business model. The first objective is to understand how professional clients currently manage digital assets, what problems they face, where existing solutions fall short, and whether there is a meaningful commercial opportunity for Tangem.

Based on this research, the person will define who we should target, what we should build, how we should go to market, and how Tangem can monetize the opportunity.

1. Market Research & Customer Discovery

  • Interview family offices, HNWs, RIAs, wealth managers, corporate treasuries, custodians, and other relevant players
  • Understand current digital-asset custody, security, governance, recovery, and reporting processes
  • Map existing solutions and competitors
  • Identify unmet needs, purchasing behavior, and willingness to adopt self-custody or hybrid models
  • Prioritize the most attractive customer segments, use cases, potential partners, and pilot customers

2. Product & Business Strategy

Based on the findings:

  • Define priority customer segments and use cases
  • Develop Tangem's value proposition and positioning
  • Identify required product capabilities and integrations
  • Recommend an MVP / pilot
  • Define regulatory and operational considerations
  • Build an initial go-to-market strategy

Potential requirements could include multi-user approvals, permissions, transaction controls, audit trails, recovery, reporting, and integrations - but these should be validated through research rather than assumed upfront.

3. Monetization & P&L

  • Identify and validate potential revenue models
  • Define pricing and packaging
  • Assess customer willingness to pay
  • Estimate market and revenue potential
  • Define required product, sales, operational, and support investments
  • Build an initial P&L, including revenue, margins, costs, and break-even scenarios
  • Define commercial KPIs and investment required to launch and scale

Key Deliverables

The project should result in:

  1. Market and customer research with prioritized segments and use cases
  2. Recommended product / MVP and value proposition
  3. Go-to-market and partnership strategy
  4. Monetization and pricing model
  5. Potential pilot customer and partner pipeline
  6. Financial model and P&L
  7. Final go / no-go recommendation and launch roadmap

Ideal Background

We are looking for someone with senior experience in private wealth, family offices, RIAs, institutional digital assets, custody, corporate treasury, private banking, or WealthTech / FinTech.

The ideal candidate should have a strong US industry network, experience in customer discovery and new business development, and the ability to translate market insights into product strategy, commercial model, and P&L.

What we offer

  • Stability, growth, participation in shaping the future unicorn.
  • Remote work from any location.
  • Competitive salary in EURO/USDT.
  • Unlimited vacation.
  • Compensation for the purchase of necessary technical devices for the work.

Feel free to send you CV to Ivan - ipanteleev@tangem.com

descriptions.job-0lnjqun:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Responsibilities

  • Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.
  • Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.
  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions
  • Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline. 
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. 
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.
  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
  • Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.
  • Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.
  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
descriptions.job-1vb9prj:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

Role

Morpho's Midnight launch brought fixed-rate, fixed-term lending onchain, and with it a set of credit markets that were never viable before. This role decides which of those markets Morpho pursues, what each one demands, and how to get there. It exists because the opportunity is far larger than the team can chase at once, so the sequencing has to be right.

Responsibilities

  • Own Morpho's strategy for expanding into new credit markets, building the framework that sizes and sequences each opportunity so the team goes after the ones that will gain real traction.

  • Size net new markets including custodied Bitcoin, tokenized equities, undercollateralized credit and credit card receivables, using market data and competitive dynamics to decide where Morpho moves first.

  • Build and run the process that surfaces what institutions actually need across a range of use cases and industries, so Morpho knows which problems to solve to unlock each loan type.

  • Work with protocol, engineering, solutions, partnerships, marketing and legal to decide where Morpho builds and where it partners, then ship multiple zero-to-one loan categories.

  • Design and run proof of concepts with new counterparty types, then use the results to scale a proven model across the rest of that market.

  • Map the regulatory, compliance and registration requirements attached to each new market and factor them into which opportunities Morpho takes on, and in what order.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

Ramped on the lending stack and what Midnight makes possible. Has met markets, solutions, partnerships and protocol, and mapped the credit opportunities already in play.

First 3 months

You drove delivery of a proof of concept for a new loan market, and helped the team size the broader landscape of where to move next.

First 6 months

You've shipped experiments across several categories and developed internal consensus on our strategy to expand morpho into new markets.

Must Have Experience & Skills:

  • Proven track record taking products from zero to one in greenfield markets.

  • Experience in crypto, traditional finance, or fintech, with a working grasp of how credit markets function.

  • Experience shipping products with regulatory or compliance requirements.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to create clarity and drive decisions in highly ambiguous environments

  • Fast synthesis, with the ability to ramp on unfamiliar industries and markets quickly.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

The Security & Information team is looking for someone who is passionate about technology and has a roll-up-their-sleeves mentality to join our global team. You’ll play a crucial role in enhancing our security infrastructure, improving networking, ensuring scalability, and maintaining strong security as we continue to grow. If you want to be an industry leader, on a team experiencing hyper-growth, look no further! 

What you’ll do 

As a SecOps Specialist, you’ll be responsible for securing and protecting our infrastructure, including managing and administering various security-related technologies, platforms, and tools. You'll also provide security expertise and guidance to the team on various security-related matters. You’ll build and own solutions to quickly identify breach attempts, contain and eradicate threats, streamline our security incident response processes, continuously test our controls, and help the business make informed decisions based on threat intelligence. This is a fast-paced environment, where you’ll have the opportunity to manage multiple projects at once.

This role will have required shifts on some weekends and nights. 

Responsibilities 

  • Investigate alerts, triage, deep dive and come up with proper action items and remediation plans. 
  • Perform host-based analysis, artifact analysis, and malware analysis in support of security investigations and incident response.

  • Develop incident analysis and findings reports for management, including gap identification and recommendations for improvement.
  • Recommend or develop new detection logic and tune existing sensors/security controls.
  • Work with security solutions owners to assess existing security solutions ability to detect/mitigate the above mentioned TTPs.
  • Creating custom SIEM queries and dashboards to support the monitoring and detection of advanced TTPs against the company network. 

Minimum Requirements 

  • 3+ years experience working in an Incident Response/Cyber Security Operations Center (in-house or outsourced) creating, escalating, and managing security incidents and creating incident reports.
    • Managing low to high-risk cybersecurity events, alerts, and incidents, event monitoring, and analysis, and responding to and escalating IT/DevOps security events and threats and vulnerabilities.
    • Collaborating with stakeholders to drive incident response and remediation.
    • Development of common runbooks for most frequent or critical incident types.
  • 3+ years of working with security tools such as SIEM, Analytics & Intelligence, Intrusion Detection, Malware detection, Data Loss Protection, and Identity & Access Management
  • Solid understanding of system and security controls on at least two OSs (Windows, Linux / Unix, and MacOS (Advantage), including host-based forensics and experience with analyzing OS artifacts.
  • Problem solver, an in-depth thinker with a growth mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with other teams 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

For employees hired to work remotely from New York, or from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role.
